entities.summary: Adwaita Mallabarman, was a Bengali writer and journalist based in India. Today, he is best known for the novel, Titas Ekti Nadir Naam, which was published posthumously in 1956, following his death in 1951. He was briefly associated with Anandabazar Patrika, Yugantar and Desh. Advaita Mallabarmana was a authors & novelists from Brahmanbaria District (1914, Brahmanbaria District–1951-04-16). A moderately significant entity in the historical record.
